真实的热解气是许多种气体的混合物，这里用最简单的甲烷来说明。动画合并了许多反应步: Real pyrolysis gas is a mixture of many gases. Here methane provides a simple example. The animation combines many reaction steps.
纤维素、半纤维素和木质素受热断裂，放出一大群小分子和焦油，留下炭。: Heat breaks down cellulose, hemicellulose and lignin into gases and tar, leaving char behind.
绝干木头的燃烧热约18–20 MJ/kg；这团火的模型按14 MJ/kg有效热值: Oven-dry wood: about 18–20 MJ/kg. This model uses an effective 14 MJ/kg.
这团火每秒烧掉约 {fuel} 克可燃气，相当于 {kettles} 个电水壶的: About {fuel} g/s of equivalent fuel gas: the power of {kettles} kettles.
这里只演示生成二氧化碳的一条配平反应，不代表炭床只走这一条路径。: This shows one balanced reaction forming carbon dioxide, not the only pathway in the coal bed.
风会改变空气与燃料相遇的位置。: Wind changes where air and fuel meet.
观察分子时，篝火已暂停；返回后恢复原来的时间状态。: Fire time is paused here. Returning restores your previous playback state.

断键需要能量，成键释放能量。整个燃烧反应释放得更多，能量差成为热。: Bond breaking takes energy; formation releases it. Combustion releases more overall as heat.

按热烟炱或反应阈值逐层计时，含边缘淡出，高度从0.05 m起算。预测用同期平均功: Time flame presence by layer, including boundary fade; measure from 0.05 m. Prediction uses mean power and D=0.60 m. Logs differ from a pool fire.
以20 Hz采放热、高度和三处温度。40秒频谱分辨率0.025 Hz，至少两种信: Sample power, height and three temperatures at 20 Hz. A 40 s spectrum resolves 0.025 Hz; report only clear peaks shared by two signals.
微重力烛火靠分子扩散补氧。本模型没有这种扩散，源流和湍流仍在，不能复现NASA烛: Microgravity candles rely on diffusion. This model omits it and retains source flow and turbulence; it cannot reproduce NASA's candle.
累加每格燃料消耗，假定14 MJ/kg、密度353/T kg/m³。克数是等效可: Sum fuel consumed, assuming 14 MJ/kg and density 353/T kg/m³. Grams mean equivalent gas, not weighed wood; kettles are 2 kW each.
静止空气中的微重力烛火主要靠分子扩散补氧。这里依据实验做示意；篝火模型未算这种扩: In still microgravity air, diffusion supplies oxygen. This illustration follows experiments; the campfire model omits diffusion.
可用空气 = 1 − 燃料 − 产物与惰性气体。乘23.2%可估算氧质量分数，不: Available air = 1 − fuel − products/inert gas. Multiply by 23.2% to estimate oxygen mass fraction; oxygen is not separately solved.
固定木柴表面供气，未算木柴传热、消耗、水或分子扩散，不能作灭火或微重力预测。: Fixed logs supply gas. Wood heating/depletion, water and diffusion are omitted; this is not an extinction or microgravity predictor.
剖面读原始场；实景叠加整条视线的光和细节噪声。两种颜色不能逐像素等同。: Slices read raw fields; the image integrates light along a ray with detail noise. Their colors are not equivalent pixel values.
蓝光是放热驱动的近似，未逐个求解CH*、C₂*、OH或CO₂。颜色、亮度经过相机: Blue light is a heat-driven approximation, without individual CH*, C2*, OH or CO2. Color and brightness undergo camera processing.
积分ρcp·q，温度取反应后。温度上限和密度近似使它不同于化学估算；两者都非实验: Integrate rho·cp·q at post-reaction temperature. The temperature cap and density estimate cause differences; neither is calorimetry.
蜡蒸气分解生成烟炱，热颗粒发黄光。亮度也受颗粒多少影响，不能单独判断温度。: Wax vapor forms soot. Hot particles glow yellow, but their abundance also affects brightness: it is not a thermometer.
液蜡沿烛芯上升、汽化。焰心富含蜡蒸气，少氧；暗处也有燃料。: Wax rises along the wick and vaporizes. The dark core is fuel-rich and oxygen-poor, not empty.
外侧燃料遇见氧，反应更充分。外缘常比黄色亮区热，却不那么亮。: Fuel meets oxygen at the edge. More complete reaction often makes it hotter than the bright yellow region.
高温下H、O、OH参与反应接力；传播、分支和终止决定燃烧能否继续。: H, O and OH carry reactions. Propagation, branching and termination sustain or end combustion.
碳、氢与氧重组为二氧化碳和水。这里举甲烷的例子，蜡分子更复杂：: Carbon and hydrogen recombine with oxygen into CO2 and water. Methane is the example; wax is more complex:
温度、燃料、烟炱、速度来自网格插值；木柴内部没有气体读数。: Temperature, fuel, soot and velocity are interpolated from the grid. No gas readings inside wood.
放热图是燃烧升温率K/s，不是温度或整团火的kW；气体还会辐射、混合冷却。: The map shows combustion heating in K/s, not temperature or total kW. Radiation and mixing also cool the gas.
烟炱生成门限为15–50 ms，还需高温。年龄计燃料来源气体的老化，不是温度。: Soot starts at 15–50 ms with sufficient heat. Age tracks fuel-derived gas, not temperature.
录像没有实时读数。黄色来自烟炱，蓝色含化学发光；颜色不能单独测温。: Video has no live readings. Yellow comes from soot; blue includes chemiluminescence. Color alone cannot measure temperature.
文献蜡烛：77±9 W · 高42±1 mm，非本画面实测。: Published candle: 77±9 W, height 42±1 mm. Not measured from this image.
尾气含CO₂、水蒸气、未燃尽CO和颗粒；CO₂与水蒸气本身不是烟粒。: Exhaust carries CO2, water vapor, unburned CO and particles. CO2 and water vapor are not smoke particles.
年轻气体少烟炱，15–50毫秒渐启生成；微弱蓝光来自反应的化学发光。: Young gas has little soot; formation ramps up at 15–50 ms. Faint blue light is chemiluminescence.
烟含未烧完的颗粒和凝结物；热气还含不可见气体，模型未分别求其浓度。: Smoke contains particles and condensates; invisible gas concentrations are not separately solved.
纤维素链的局部，两端省略。断键仅示意，片段不是唯一的热解产物。: Cellulose chain segment, ends omitted. Bond cleavage is illustrative, not a unique pyrolysis pathway.
缺氧热区中，碳氢分子长成多环结构、聚成烟炱。热烟炱发黄光。: In hot, oxygen-poor gas, hydrocarbons form rings and soot. Hot soot glows yellow.
断键需能，成键放能。甲烷燃烧成键释放更多能量，总体放热。: Breaking bonds takes energy; forming bonds releases it. Methane combustion releases more overall.
氧与炭反应，让裂缝、余烬发红。这里读炭床上方气温。: Oxygen reacting with char makes cracks and embers glow. The reading is gas above the bed.
小炭粒随气流飞起，继续氧化直到熄灭。读数来自当前存活火星。: Char fragments rise, oxidize and go dark. Readings come from live spark particles.
两团碳骨架靠近、聚集；不是完整成炱反应，也非探针测到的分子。: Carbon frameworks aggregate: not a complete soot mechanism or probe-identified molecules.
一个甲烷和两个氧分子变成一个CO₂、两个水分子。原子不消失，只重组。: CH4 and two O2 become one CO2 and two H2O. Atoms are rearranged, not lost.
展示可能物质，不表示当前比例；流动场未分别求这些分子浓度。: Possible constituents, not current proportions. Their concentrations are not separately solved.
热烟炱发黄光；颗粒多少、视线厚度也影响亮度，最亮未必最热。: Hot soot glows yellow. Abundance and optical depth affect brightness; brightest need not be hottest.
热气上升，周围空气补入。横切时朝火心的箭头显示卷吸。: Hot gas rises and air flows in. Inward arrows on a horizontal slice show entrainment.
木头先失水，受热分解出可燃气；眼前的火焰主要烧这些气体。: Wood dries, then releases combustible gases as it breaks down. These feed most of the flame.
静止空气中的小烛火较平顺，是层流；篝火有强烈的湍流卷动。: A small candle in still air is laminar and smooth; a campfire has strong turbulent motion.
